title: Exercise 2 Starter: Persistent Service
description: The starter run command for the second exercise, which recreates a container with the same mount to show the data survived.

steps.description: Run Open WebUI detached, named `webui`, and publish host port 3000 to container port 8080.
Bind-mount `$HOME/agents/openwebui/data` to the app's data directory, so chats, settings, and accounts live on your disk.
Use the Open WebUI image. The exercise says the second run command after `docker rm webui` is identical, and that is the whole point: the same mount brings the account back.
